job.email_subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer – UST
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Thank you for sharing UST's urgent SAP openings – I bring 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) delivery at Rockwell Automation and Shell.

– Java/Spring and OCC REST APIs
– PIM / ERP / MDM integrations
– SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User

I work independently and results-driven in international, agile teams – remote, hybrid or on-site. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/kranti-chavan-84a155191. My CV and cover letter are attached. I would be glad to show you in a short call what I can deliver for UST.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring, OCC APIs & Integrations
tailoring.summary: SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years building and supporting enterprise B2B and B2C platforms (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, OCC REST web services for headless commerce and PIM / ERP / MDM integrations with Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders. Hands-on with Promotions Engine, OMS, Cronjobs, Impex, Backoffice and HAC, SQL and FlexibleSearch tuning, and CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2. Code reviews, mentoring and techno-functional work with business stakeholders. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: UST delivers SAP transformations for large enterprise clients, and urgent openings need someone productive from the first sprint. My SAP Commerce Cloud experience on two large global platforms means I know the client environment, the integrations and the release process. I would be glad to contribute to UST's SAP practice from Germany.

en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer – UST
en.hook: Thank you for sharing UST's urgent SAP openings. For any SAP Commerce Cloud role among them, I bring more than five years of delivery at Rockwell Automation and Shell on Hybris 2105 and 2211 – Java and Spring development, OCC APIs and complex PIM / ERP / MDM integrations – as an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce delivery
bullets.text: Designed and implemented product, catalog, pricing and customer data functionality on Hybris 2211; developed Promotions Engine, OMS, Cronjobs and Impex.

bullets.label: Headless & APIs
bullets.text: Developed OCC REST web services and RESTful APIs for storefronts, PWA frontends and third-party consumers.

bullets.label: Integrations
bullets.text: Built PIM-to-Hybris pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub and resolved bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee.

bullets.label: Ready for client projects
bullets.text: Code reviews, production support, mentoring of junior developers and CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2).
